in_marathi.name: Ranvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of a hero or ruler
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ranvansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Ran' which means 'Joy' and 'Vansh' which means 'Descent' or 'Progeny'. This name signifies the descendant of a hero or a great ruler.
